title: App view descriptor (app-views/v1)
description: A versioned, data-only declaration of the record views a workspace app package may describe for the trusted host shell: named views of kinds table/detail/form, declared fields with an allowlisted format vocabulary, and table columns that may only name declared fields. The descriptor is data, never code — keys that name executable surfaces (script/code/html/css/eval/import/module), URLs or navigation (url/href/src/link/action/endpoint), scope or actor identity (install_id/context_id/workspace/project/actor/by/role/scope/capability), credentials (secret/credential/token/password), storage internals (sql/query/path/file), or authority claims (effect/verified/digest/revision) are forbidden at every level and are enforced by the consumer's recursive scan; this schema additionally forbids them at each object's `propertyNames`. Identifier grammar is [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}. Consumers must also enforce the bounds documented here (max views/fields/columns, string lengths, unique view/field ids, enum/format coherence, and fixture rows keyed only by declared field ids) — JSON Schema alone cannot express duplicate ids or cross-references.

contract.description: The contract tag. A descriptor naming any other version is refused.

app.description: The workspace-app kind this descriptor was reviewed with (e.g. crm, social-content). Provenance only — never an installation id, route, or authority claim.

title.description: Human title for the descriptor — plain text.

views.description: Named views; ids unique within the descriptor (consumer-checked).

values.description: Allowed values — required on format "enum", forbidden on every other format (consumer-checked).

createView.description: Names a declared form view in the same descriptor (consumer-checked).

field.description: Must equal a field id declared on the same view (consumer-checked).

fields.description: table/detail only: declared fields; ids unique (consumer-checked).

columns.description: table only: which declared fields become columns (consumer-checked).

previewOf.description: form only: the fields a disabled host-form preview shows; the descriptor declares no live mutation.
